Hey guys, welcome to La Rosa

We're Lonchera La Rosa, the bright red taco truck on Lansing Ave NE in Salem. Authentic Mexican food, made at the window while you wait.

Tortas on crispy bread, carne asada tacos, and burritos big enough for lunch and dinner. Pick your meat: asada, pastor, pollo, carnitas, chorizo, lengua, tripa, camarón. Then pick a salsa. Ask for the mango hot sauce. 4.9 stars from 103 Google reviews.

Find us at 1733 Lansing Ave NE, a block off Market St, with free parking and a patio. Open Monday to Friday, noon to 7pm.

Our story

Salem's bright red taco truck

Lonchera La Rosa is the bright red taco truck on Lansing Ave NE. Authentic Mexican food, made at the window: tacos, tortas, burritos and quesadillas, with your choice of meat and a lineup of house salsas.

Before Lansing we were on Lancaster Dr, where the Statesman Journal listed us among Salem's places to try for Hispanic Heritage Month. In October 2024 we moved to our own lot at 1733 Lansing Ave NE, with free parking and a patio.

You'll also find the truck out at Powerland Heritage Park for the Great Oregon Steam-Up, the Swap Meet and STEAM'd Up for Kids, at Salem's Riverfront for the NorthWest Taco Fest, and at North Salem High's homecoming carnival.
